text: HI THREADS! started experimenting in unreal engine with the lighting and stuff and i think this looks pretty close to what we are envisioning! i kinda want a tighter ambient occlusion, but we arent sure how to do that yet. i like the juxtaposition of toy-like assets and more realistic lighting, it makes it looks like a diorama which i LOVE! i love games that feel like im a kid again playing with little toys 🥹
